title: Notes about these notes
lead: Where this book came from, how its chapters depend on one another, which courses it has served, the computer resources that go with it, and whom the author thanks.
notes: The section note that this section is for the instructor is left out, and since the book’s Further Reading chapter is not built, each work cited here is given in a footnote at its citation.
exercise_notes: The book sets no exercises in this section.
